intro: (EXAMPLE CONTENT) Rain has been falling on the Old Svalich Road for three days. The gatehouse before you is a black shape in the mist: two towers, one broken, and a gate that stands open because there is no one left to close it.
(EXAMPLE CONTENT) A bell hangs somewhere above. It has not rung in years. In the village below, they say the dead walk when the bell is silent.

(EXAMPLE CONTENT) The Old Gatehouse and East Gate staging map are invented test locations. The Village of Barovia town square (E3) is a small source-adapted excerpt with placeholder prose; the full adventure is not implemented.
defeat: The mist takes the last of your lantern light. Somewhere above, the bell does not ring.
